          %4 = OpString "/app/example.hlsl"
               OpSource HLSL 600 %4 "//==========================================================================//
// Issue 3927: an unused texture/sampler pair still consumes a descriptor binding.
//
// Every path through main() ends in OpKill, so the value sampled from the first texture cannot
// affect any output -- yet both DXC panes still emit a variable for that texture and its
// sampler and give each one a DescriptorSet and a Binding. The decoration block near the top of
// each pane is the place to look: of the four resources the shader declares, only that first
// pair is decorated there, at bindings 0 and 1.
//
// The contrast is the point. The second pair is used only on the unreachable return statement,
// and it is eliminated completely -- it has no variable and no decoration anywhere in the
// module. Dead resource elimination is running and working; it stops short here because the
// surviving sample feeds a branch condition, and nothing folds a branch whose two targets both
// end in OpKill. Those two OpKill instructions are the last two blocks of the function.
//
// One caution when reading a pane: Compiler Explorer builds with source embedding on, so the
// whole shader -- and this banner -- is quoted back inside the OpSource string at the top of
// each pane. Read the decoration block and the variable declarations rather than searching the
// pane text for a resource name, which will hit that quoted copy.
//
// Both panes agree, and so does every DXC release from v1.5.2010, the first with a SPIR-V
// backend, through v1.9.2607.
//==========================================================================//

struct PixelInput
{
        float4 pos : SV_Position0;
        float2 texCoord : TEXCOORD0;
};

Texture2D Tex0;
SamplerState SS0;
Texture2D Tex1;
SamplerState SS1;

float4 main(in PixelInput In) : SV_Target0
{
        const float2 val = Tex0.Sample(SS0, In.texCoord).xy;
        if (((val.x == 0.0f) && (val.y == 0.0f)))
        {
                clip(-1.0f);
        }
        clip(-0.5f);
        return Tex1.Sample(SS1, In.texCoord);
}
"
               OpName %type_2d_image "type.2d.image"
               OpName %Tex0 "Tex0"
               OpName %type_sampler "type.sampler"
               OpName %SS0 "SS0"
               OpName %in_var_TEXCOORD0 "in.var.TEXCOORD0"
               OpName %out_var_SV_Target0 "out.var.SV_Target0"
               OpName %main "main"
               OpName %type_sampled_image "type.sampled.image"
               OpDecorate %in_var_TEXCOORD0 Location 0
               OpDecorate %out_var_SV_Target0 Location 0
               OpDecorate %Tex0 DescriptorSet 0
               OpDecorate %Tex0 Binding 0
               OpDecorate %SS0 DescriptorSet 0
               OpDecorate %SS0 Binding 1
      %float = OpTypeFloat 32
    %float_0 = OpConstant %float 0
%type_2d_image = OpTypeImage %float 2D 2 0 0 1 Unknown
%_ptr_UniformConstant_type_2d_image = OpTypePointer UniformConstant %type_2d_image
%type_sampler = OpTypeSampler
%_ptr_UniformConstant_type_sampler = OpTypePointer UniformConstant %type_sampler
    %v4float = OpTypeVector %float 4
    %v2float = OpTypeVector %float 2
%_ptr_Input_v2float = OpTypePointer Input %v2float
%_ptr_Output_v4float = OpTypePointer Output %v4float
       %void = OpTypeVoid
         %19 = OpTypeFunction %void
%type_sampled_image = OpTypeSampledImage %type_2d_image
       %bool = OpTypeBool
       %Tex0 = OpVariable %_ptr_UniformConstant_type_2d_image UniformConstant
        %SS0 = OpVariable %_ptr_UniformConstant_type_sampler UniformConstant
%in_var_TEXCOORD0 = OpVariable %_ptr_Input_v2float Input
%out_var_SV_Target0 = OpVariable %_ptr_Output_v4float Output
       %main = OpFunction %void None %19
         %21 = OpLabel
         %22 = OpLoad %v2float %in_var_TEXCOORD0
               OpLine %4 38 21

               OpLine %4 38 33
         %24 = OpLoad %type_sampler %SS0
               OpLine %4 38 21
         %25 = OpSampledImage %type_sampled_image %23 %24
         %26 = OpImageSampleImplicitLod %v4float %25 %22 None
               OpLine %4 39 8
         %27 = OpCompositeExtract %float %26 0
               OpLine %4 39 14
         %28 = OpFOrdEqual %bool %27 %float_0
               OpLine %4 39 27
         %29 = OpCompositeExtract %float %26 1
               OpLine %4 39 33
         %30 = OpFOrdEqual %bool %29 %float_0
               OpLine %4 39 23
         %31 = OpLogicalAnd %bool %28 %30
               OpLine %4 40 2
               OpSelectionMerge %32 None
               OpBranchConditional %31 %33 %32
         %33 = OpLabel
               OpLine %4 41 3
               OpKill
         %32 = OpLabel
               OpLine %4 43 2
               OpKill
               OpFunctionEnd
